title: Pixel-KWS: Rendered-Glyph Representations for Orthographically Robust Open-Vocabulary Keyword Spotting
abstract: arXiv:2611.19389v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary keyword spotting (KWS) allows users to enroll arbitrary keywords at inference time. However, character and phoneme-based text encoders rely on fixed symbol vocabularies learned during training, limiting their ability to handle unseen or visually similar symbols such as homoglyphs, l33tspeak substitutions, and accented characters. We propose PIXEL-KWS, an open-vocabulary KWS framework that represents characters through rendered glyphs rather than learned embedding lookups. We render each character as a grayscale image and encode it with a lightweight CNN, enabling the text encoder to generalize from visual form rather than a fixed vocabulary. On LibriPhrase, PIXEL-KWS and its matched character-based counterpart achieve 9.57% and 9.55% EER on LibriPhrase-hard, 0.43% and 0.41% EER on LibriPhrase-easy, outperforming all published baselines without pre-training or synthetic data. translated_title: Pixel-KWS：面向正字法鲁棒开放词汇关键词检测的渲染字形表示
translated_abstract: 开放词汇关键词检测（KWS）允许用户在推理时注册任意关键词。然而，基于字符和音素的文本编码器依赖于训练期间学到的固定符号词表，这限制了它们处理未见过的或视觉上相似符号的能力，例如同形异码字、l33tspeak 替换字符和带变音符的字符。我们提出 PIXEL-KWS，一种通过渲染字形而非学习到的嵌入查表来表示字符的开放词汇 KWS 框架。我们将每个字符渲染为灰度图像，并用轻量级 CNN 进行编码，使文本编码器能够从视觉形态而非固定词表进行泛化。在 LibriPhrase 数据集上，PIXEL-KWS 与其对应的基于字符的匹配模型在 LibriPhrase-hard 上分别取得 9.57% 和 9.55% 的 EER，在 LibriPhrase-easy 上分别取得 0.43% 和 0.41% 的 EER，在无需预训练或合成数据的情况下超越了所有已发表的基线。PIXEL-KWS 提供了显著更强的鲁棒性……
tldr: PIXEL-KWS 用渲染的灰度字形图像加轻量级 CNN 编码替代基于固定词表的嵌入查表，使开放词汇关键词检测对同形字、l33tspeak 等视觉相似符号更鲁棒，并在 LibriPhrase 上无需预训练或合成数据即超越所有已发表基线。
en_tdlr: PIXEL-KWS replaces learned embedding lookups with rendered grayscale glyph images encoded by a lightweight CNN, enabling orthographically robust open-vocabulary keyword spotting that outperforms all published baselines on LibriPhrase without pre-training or synthetic data.
